description: The primary cause of the training loop crash was the initialization mapping bug in the `Block` class where `self.resid_lambdas` (the class dictionary attribute) were incorrectly assigned to the forward pass parameters (`self.x` and `self.x0`) instead of the class dictionary attributes (`self.resid_lambdas`). This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step due to empty tensors (or non-zero gradient inputs on the first step), resulting in the loss exploding to infinity and crashing the training loop. By correctly assigning `self.x` and `self.x0` to the forward pass parameters and `self.resid_lambdas` to the class dictionary, the optimizer can initialize with gradients from the first step, stabilizing the val_bpb to ~0.9912.
